[http://www.sabrent.com/drivers.php Sabrent] provides drivers for a Ralink version and a Realtek version.
This device is listed on the [http://wiki.tinycorelinux.net/wiki:list_of_supported_wifi_devices '''Tiny Core Linux''' Supported Hardware Table].
There are likely additional revisions of this device - the '''Amazon''' spec info indicates the device is 300Mbps capable and some '''Amazon''' reviewers indicates some devices used '''Ralink''' chipsets...
